visualSpotCheck.method: Read-only System.Drawing neutral-ivory composite shown at 900x900; entire source retained
visualSpotCheck.finding: Both wing tips and tail visibly intact. Alpha>=16 bbox [10,14,1250,1194] gives 10px left and 4px right margin; this source is tightly framed but has no meaningful-alpha clipping. Maintain export safe margin through shared downscale; redraw is not required solely for this edge audit.

conclusions: All 28 formal sources are included. Candidate rows are excluded from formal totals.
Extreme RGB diagnostic pixels: alpha 1..15 = 119187; alpha 16..127 = 0; alpha 128..255 = 13.
The existing source-preserving remote-alpha-one rule can deterministically clear 3686 remote pixels from derived exports.
Do not globally remove purple/blue/pink/yellow material colors. Where alpha>=16 extreme-color counts are zero, tool-display color artifacts do not establish opaque paint contamination.
Final shared-scale export and composite checks remain necessary; original PNGs were neither changed nor re-encoded.

The only 13 formal-source strong-alpha extreme-color pixels are the intended red waist-knot/tassel decoration in 14-feierling E/W, verified by exact coordinates and neutral-background views; preserve these pixels. No unresolved meaningful-alpha clipping or key-color fringe remains.
